title: INC: Card payments failing (processor_unavailable)
author: Miles Thornton
content:
h1. INC: Card payments failing (processor_unavailable)

Status: resolved.

h1. Window
2026-08-17 22:00 UTC to 2026-08-18 06:00 UTC.

h1. Impact
Card payments attempted in the window failed with `processor_unavailable`. Other billing operations were unaffected.

h1. Resolution
The payment processor restored availability. Payments that failed in the window were retried automatically; the last retries completed on 2026-08-21. No late fees were applied.
